title: The Last Office
summary: Mother Agnes has read the rolls and wishes she hadn't: the Abbess Below keeps the choir-lamp lit, and the Cult harvests what's in it. Three hundred and twelve professed. Agnes wants them let go.

steps.journal: Go down to the Drowned Abbey's chapter-house, the third floor's hall, and put down the Abbess Below. The water comes in with her bells; keep out of it.

ready: The Abbess is down and the choir-lamp broken. Take her ledger to Sister Ilse at the Shrine of the Ember in Thornwick.
done: Ilse read the Abbey's ledger twice: the Cult was mining the dead, for the Kell Assay. Act II is done.
